description: Defines classes and templates for managing WebSocket topic subscriptions, including Topic, Subscriber, and TopicTree, with methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, publishing messages, and draining subscribers.

classes.name: uWS::Topic
classes.description: Represents a topic as a set of Subscriber pointers, with a name.

classes.name: uWS::Subscriber
classes.description: Represents a subscriber with topics, message indices, and drainage state.

classes.name: uWS::TopicTree
classes.description: Manages topics and subscribers, providing methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, publishing, and draining messages.

methods.name: checkIteratingSubscriber
methods.description: Checks if the subscriber is currently being iterated over and terminates if so.

methods.name: drainImpl
methods.description: Processes outgoing messages for a subscriber during drain.

methods.name: unlinkDrainableSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the drainable list.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a subscriber to a topic.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes a subscriber from a topic.

methods.name: freeSubscriber
methods.description: Frees a subscriber and removes it from all topics.

methods.name: drain
methods.description: Drains a specific subscriber's outgoing messages.

methods.name: drain
methods.description: Drains all subscribers with pending messages.

methods.name: publishBig
methods.description: Publishes a large message directly to subscribers, bypassing buffering.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to all subscribers of a topic.
